cover.designReason: Bold left cover title and paired photographic plates preserve the reference cover hierarchy.

toc.designReason: Large directory heading and colored circles structure the actual chapter names.

content.designReason: Three small views introduce a single lower-left article opposite a tall portrait.

visualAcceptance.scope: All 30 current-batch full-size pages plus reference/deck overview inspected. No previous-batch image substituted for a changed page. Whole principal image/text relationships, complete paragraphs, hierarchy, source continuity and same-role chapter policy assessed.
